The evidence is supported by multiple paths that highlight the binding of these compounds to Adrb1, with the lowest common ancestor (LCA) of Bisoprolol and its relatives being the beta-adrenergic antagonist class. The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, though the exact strength of the association may vary.
